description.en: The ID of the change set.

description.en: The ID of the region to which the change set belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
是否获取模板，取值：

- true：获取模板。
- false（默认值）：不获取模板。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return the template. Valid values:

- true: The template is returned.

- false (default): The template is not returned.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，为您查询杭州地域ID为`4c11658d-bd47-4dd0-ba64-727edc62****`的更改集信息。
descriptions.en: This topic demonstrates how to query a change set with the ID `4c11658d-bd47-4dd0-ba64-727edc62****` in the China (Hangzhou) region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros get-change-set --show-template false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --change-set-id 4c11658d-bd47-4dd0-ba64-727edc620000 --region cn-hangzhou
